# SAUDEX GLOBAL

> SAUDEX GLOBAL provides technology-driven logistics, freight, warehousing, supply chain, import-export, distribution, and transportation solutions across Asia and the Middle East.

## Website
- https://saudexglobal.com/

## Core Services
- Global logistics solutions
- Import and export services
- Freight forwarding
- Warehousing services
- Supply chain logistics
- Transportation services
- Distribution and last-mile delivery
- Customs clearance and compliance
- FMCG distribution
- Temperature-controlled logistics

## Primary Topics

### Global Logistics Solutions
SAUDEX GLOBAL offers reliable, scalable, and technology-driven global logistics solutions for businesses operating across Asia and the Middle East.

### Import and Export
Import and export services include documentation, customs compliance, cargo preparation, shipment coordination, and cross-border trade support.

### Freight Forwarding
Freight forwarding services cover air, sea, and land cargo with end-to-end coordination, shipment tracking, safety, and compliance support.

### Warehousing Services
Warehousing services include flexible and contract storage, inventory management, real-time stock reporting, secure facilities, and dedicated warehousing solutions.

### Supply Chain Logistics
Supply chain logistics services include operational assessments, consulting, inventory planning, optimization, bottleneck reduction, and practical implementation.

### Transportation Services
Transportation services include regional distribution, bulk distribution, scheduled routes, last-mile delivery, distribution management, and integrated transportation support.
